peircean_analysis.firstness: Email from hr@corp.com, subject 'Condolencias - Fondo para familia de Juan Pérez', with attachment donaciones.pdf. SPF: fail. DKIM: fail. PDF contains embedded JavaScript accessing session_id/auth_token/csrf cookies and sending to family-support[.]org via CVE-2023-21608. 12 internal hosts connected to family-support[.]org within 30 minutes of PDF mass-open. Juan Pérez not found in personnel database. Real HR did not send the email.
peircean_analysis.secondness: SPF+DKIM dual failure = spoofed sender domain. Non-existent employee = fabricated pretext. PDF JavaScript = technical exploit delivery. 12-host callback = successful exploitation. family-support[.]org = attacker-controlled C2. Four independent corroborating facts establish a complete phishing-to-compromise chain.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: Emotional manipulation via social taboo (death/condolence) to bypass technical distrust: recipients suppress security skepticism when presented with bereavement context (Carnegie: emotional manipulation overrides rational threat assessment). Fabricated identity + spoofed sender + exploit PDF + C2 exfiltration = complete spear-phishing operation.

hypotheses.H1_spear_phishing_operation: Attacker spoofed HR, used fake deceased employee to bypass defenses, delivered PDF exploit, exfiltrated session tokens from 12 hosts.
hypotheses.H2_legitimate_email_error: Real HR employee sent a legitimate condolence email with a benign PDF attachment; SPF/DKIM failures are mail server misconfiguration.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H2: SPF/DKIM misconfiguration is very common. PDF attachments from HR are routine. Juan Pérez might exist under a slightly different name or in a different system.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H2 REFUTED: Juan Pérez verified NOT FOUND in personnel database. Real HR confirmed did NOT send the email. The PDF contains active JavaScript cookie theft (not a benign PDF). 12-host callback to attacker domain clinches the exploitation. H2 cannot survive these four independent facts.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 confirmed at behavioral level. However acquisition chain (prior_trust 0.30-0.35, placeholder hashes) prevents Daubert-compliant MALICE verdict. SUSPICION is the evidentiary cap.

devil_advocate: The acquisition chain is weak: prior_trust 0.30 for the email artifact, placeholder provenance hashes (sha256:a099mail01, sha256:a099pdf02). This evidence would not survive Daubert cross-examination on chain-of-custody. The behavioral pattern is damning but the forensic record-keeping is inadequate for a court finding of MALICE. SUSPICION is the honest verdict given evidence quality.
